verification_criteria.description: Source provenance must be either Level A (VERIFIED_PUBLISHER_SIGNATURE) or Level B (VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_HTTPS_ACQUISITION).
Publisher must match authoritative agency (BLS for CPI releases).
Canonical hostname must match approved official domain (www.bls.gov).
Document content must contain the relevant economic series keywords (Consumer Price Index / CPI).
Extracted reference period must match target period (e.g. October 2026 / 2026M10).
Release date and time parsed and converted to standard UTC (e.g. 2026-11-10T13:30:00Z from 08:30 EST).
Original raw document bytes SHA-256 must be computed and bound to the event identity record.
No conflicting or superseding schedule document for the same reference period exists in the evidence vault.

current_production_state.governance_note: Simulated test fixtures validated all 8 verification criteria. In accordance with governance invariants, simulated test results are not reported as real production evidence.
